sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. The leaders are in outstanding form with a recent sequence of five consecutive wins capped by their most recent victory, and face an Alsager Town side anchored at the foot of the division with just 4 points from 10 games. This should represent a straightforward opportunity for Sandbach to extend their commanding advantage at the summit.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture between mid-table sides, with Stafford looking to maintain their 2-point gap on leaders Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth, third on 19 points, face a real test against sixth-placed Bilston Town at home; despite recent form, the visitors' strong record makes this a significant encounter in the promotion picture. Wolverhampton Casuals (fourth, 19 points) host Wednesfield Community in an all-Wolverhampton derby, while Eccleshall (fifth, 18 points) welcome AFC Bridgnorth—creating a critical matchup between promotion contenders. New Mills, winless in their last two, travel to Market Drayton Town (who are also struggling with one win in their last five), a fixture between sides in need of momentum. Crewe host Allscott Heath in a clash between teams near the bottom, while Foley Meir face Bilston Town and Shawbury United welcome Barnton in other lower-mid-table encounters. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a relegation-zone battle, and Brereton Social host Widnes Town, whose seven-game winless streak leaves them rooted to the foot of the table.
